## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::ProposeInvalidTarget` — the proposed target already holds that role.

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Choose a transfer target that does not already hold the role being transferred; the current sender and recipient cannot be the new target for that role.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#17-two-step-ownership-transfer`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#17-two-step-ownership-transfer)
